turns.text: I actually started college thinking I wanted to be an elementary school teacher.
turns.zh: 其实我刚开始上大学的时候，以为我想当小学老师。

turns.text: It wasn't until my second year that I took a biology class and completely fell in love with it.
turns.zh: 直到大二我上了一门生物课，就彻底爱上它了。

turns.text: Then I changed my major to nursing.
turns.zh: 然后我就把专业转成了护理。
我从来不知道这个故事。

turns.text: So, you're saying it's totally okay to change directions completely?
turns.zh: 所以你是说，完全改变方向也完全没问题？
